item.title: Obituary - Jamie Taylor
item.description: Jamie Taylor, 48 of Butler, Missouri passed away Wednesday, January 28, 2026 at St. Luke's Plaza Hospital. Cremation, with a Celebration of Life Service to be held at a later date. Arrangements entrusted to Mullinax Funeral Home, Butler (660-679-0009). Memorial contributions may be made to the charity of donor's choice. Messages of condolence may be left for the family at www.mullinaxfuneralhome.com.A full obituary is pending at this time.

item.title: BREAKING: Daniel Ross found guilty on all counts in murder of Wesley Cobbs
